name: ai-study-planner
description: AI-Powered Personalized Study Planner – full-stack monorepo

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.type-check:all: npm run type-check -w backend && npm run type-check -w frontend
scripts.check:all: npm run lint:all && npm run type-check:all && npm run test:all
scripts.format:all: npm run format -w backend && npm run format -w frontend
